# Design deliverable routing

## Logo / mark

Focus on concept, recognizability, reproduction, monochrome/small-size behavior and required lockups.

## Corporate / brand identity

Extend an accepted visual idea into typography, color roles, grid, imagery, iconography and representative applications.

## Banner / social asset

Optimize hierarchy for the real aspect ratio and viewing distance/thumbnail scale.

## Poster

Prioritize one communication hierarchy, physical/digital production constraints and legibility.

## Icon

Design for the actual size/system. Test silhouette and optical alignment, not only the large canvas.

## Slides / visual presentation

Treat slides as a sequence of visual arguments. Use the presentation capability when the final deliverable is a slide deck.

## Campaign package

Define the shared visual system once, then adapt it across channels without forcing identical layouts.

Choose the smallest workflow matching the requested deliverable.
